content: {"praised":["Unique, off‑beat take on vampire/ werewolf genre.","Strong chemistry among cast, especially Famke Janssen.","Gripping storyline that keeps viewers guessing.","Well‑crafted supernatural mystery set in Hemlock Grove.","Engaging pacing and suspenseful tone."],"criticized":["Story feels trite and contrived.","Acting is poor and unconvincing.","Famke Janssen’s accent is ridiculous.","Clichéd writing makes it unwatchable.","Convoluted plot causes loss of interest."]}
